mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (id, account_id, source_event_id, type, channel, subject, message, delivery_state, order_id, alert_id, symbol) VALUES (#{id,javaType=java.util.UUID,typeHandler=com.trading.api.mapper.UuidTypeHandler}, #{accountId}, #{sourceEventId,javaType=java.util.UUID,typeHandler=com.trading.api.mapper.UuidTypeHandler}, #{type}, #{channel}, #{subject}, #{message}, #{deliveryState}, #{orderId,jdbcType=OTHER,javaType=java.util.UUID,typeHandler=com.trading.api.mapper.UuidTypeHandler}, #{alertId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{symbol,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ON CONFLICT (source_event_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, type, channel, subject, message, delivery_state, read_on, created_on, order_id, alert_id, symbol FROM notifications WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY created_on DESC, id
SELECT count(*) FROM notifications WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND read_on IS NULL

mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET read_on = NOW() WHERE id = #{id,javaType=java.util.UUID,typeHandler=com.trading.api.mapper.UuidTypeHandler} AND account_id = #{accountId} AND read_on IS NULL
